languageEntries.notes: Spoken in the third-person, pronoun-free style of a bonded Gand findsman (Ch18).

row.name: Less Sleep
row.description: Two hours less sleep per day.

row.name: Infravision
row.description: See heat signatures. Natural biological thermal sight.

row.name: Combat Reflexes
row.description: You react quickly to threats and keep your composure under pressure. Grants a +1 bonus to active defenses, +2 to Fright Checks, and a +6 bonus to the IQ roll to recover from mental stun (Chapter 9). Those two bonuses are the whole of what steadiness buys: it makes freezing less likely and shorter, and does not make you immune to either. Turn order is unaffected; it is set by Basic Speed and is never rolled for (Chapter 7). Prerequisite: Force Sensitive (if taken as a Force-related advantage, representing a Force-user's enhanced combat intuition).

row.name: Dependency (Ammonia)
row.description: Ammonia atmosphere; breather mask required off-world.

row.name: Greed
row.description: You have an excessive desire for wealth or possessions, often leading you to act selfishly or unethically. This makes you easily bribed or lured into dangerous schemes with promises of riches.

row.name: Follows a strict personal code

loadedAmmunitionData.notes: The universal power source for pistols and other small arms. A gas top-up (15 CR) refills it to full; free electric recharging restores the cell only, never spent gas. Bundled with the weapon — its cost and weight are already in the weapon's own figures.
